blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) stepped up its security operations in residential areas and public places to prevent crimes as preparations for the observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or “Undas” intensified. Cemeteries across the country are expected to see an influx of visitors as Filipinos observe the annual tradition of remembering their departed loved ones on Nov. 1 and 2. “Police visibility is not just about putting more personnel on the streets. “It is about preventing crime before it happens and ensuring that every family can observe Undas with peace of mind,” PNP chief […]...
